name: Sikalastic-827 HT
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-827 HT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-827 HT, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/sikalastic-827-ht.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-827 HT where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. Sikalastic®-827 HT is a modified, expanding copolymer, hot-melt pellet adhesive. It bonds mastic asphalt, stone mastic asphalt and asphalt concrete to Sika bridge deck waterproofing systems.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikalastic®-827 HT may only be used by experienced professionals.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - The pellets are used for.
    - Broadcasting onto wet Sikalastic®-8902 Broadcasting onto wet SikaCor® HM Mastic
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-827 HT
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Modified hot-melt adhesive
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Adhesive Layer in Waterproofing System ZTV-IN Part 7 Section 4, Sikalastic®-827 HT, kiwa, Test report No. P 8332-1-E
    - Bridge Waterproofing System Sikalastic®-851, BBA, Certificate No. 15/H237, according BBA HAPAS guideline
    - CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to ETA- 18/1105, based on ETAG 033 Liquid applied bridge deck waterproofing kits
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ETAG 033: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN ISO 2811-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Provides a bond between Sika spray applied waterproofing membrane and asphalt overlay
    - Provides a mechanical key due to expansion when in contact with hot asphalt
    - Develops good bond and shear strength performance
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Modified Ethyl-Vinyl-Acetate-Copolymer
    - Density: ~20 kg/l, bulk density; Values at +23 °C (EN ISO 2811-1)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Chemical resistance: Resistant to water, bitumen and de-icing salts
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 25 kg bags; Refer to current price list for packaging variations
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: ~0,70 kg/m²
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not broadcast Sikalastic®-827 HT onto the tack coat if the pot life is exceeded.
    - The asphalt paving temperature must be a minimum +140 °C on concrete deck surfaces.
    - The asphalt paving temperature must be a minimum +160 °C on steel deck surfaces.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. Refer to the individual Product Data Sheet of the tack coat system
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - The asphalt paving temperature must be a minimum +140 °C on concrete deck surfaces.
    - The asphalt paving temperature must be a minimum +160 °C on steel deck surfaces.
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: ~20 kg/l, bulk density; Values at +23 °C (EN ISO 2811-1)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-827 HT, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/sikalastic-827-ht.pdf
    - Document: Sikalastic-827HT, https://aus.sika.com/dms/getredirect.get/au01.webdms.sika.com/893
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
